articles.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
articles.snippet: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

articles.title: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
articles.snippet: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.
